transcript.content: Hello, welcome. What brings you in to see me today?
I'm here because I've been feeling deeply depressed and sad for about a year and a half now. It just feels like a heavy, constant cloud over me that I can't seem to get away from.
Have you ever had periods of time lasting at least a few days where you felt the exact opposite—extremely energized, hyperactive, or needing very little sleep?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have only felt really low, tired, and depressed this whole time.
Have you ever heard voices or seen things that other people couldn't, or held strong beliefs that others told you weren't true?
No, I've never experienced anything like that. I have never heard or seen things that aren't there, nor have I held those kinds of beliefs.
During this year and a half, have you had any periods lasting more than two months where you felt completely back to your normal self?
No, I haven't had any periods like that at all. This heavy feeling has been completely continuous for the entire year and a half, without any breaks where I felt back to my normal self.
Along with the low mood, have you noticed other changes like trouble sleeping, changes in appetite, low energy, difficulty concentrating, or thoughts of hurting yourself?

Yes, I've experienced a complete loss of energy and feel constantly exhausted, both physically and mentally, and my appetite has decreased significantly. However, I haven't had any trouble sleeping, major concentration issues other than just feeling mentally tired, or any thoughts of hurting myself.
How has your self-esteem been during this time, and do you ever feel a sense of hopelessness about the future?
I haven't really thought much about my self-esteem specifically. Mostly, I just feel completely empty and sad all the time, and I have absolutely no motivation to do anything.
Did this low mood start after a specific stressful event, loss, or major life change about a year and a half ago?

Yes, it definitely started about a year and a half ago. However, I can't recall any specific stressful event, loss, or major life change that triggered it. It just seemed to come on gradually without any obvious reason.
How have these feelings and the lack of energy affected your daily life, such as your work, hobbies, or relationships with family and friends?

I've completely withdrawn from my family and friends because even basic social interactions feel too exhausting to handle. I've also lost all interest in my hobbies, and I struggle to find any motivation or energy to get through my daily work and tasks.
Have you been experiencing feelings of worthlessness, or excessive or inappropriate guilt, during this past year and a half?

No, I haven't really experienced feelings of worthlessness or excessive guilt during this time. It is more that I just feel completely empty and exhausted, rather than blaming myself or feeling worthless.
Even though you haven't had trouble falling or staying asleep, have you found yourself sleeping much more than usual, or feeling like you are moving and speaking more slowly than normal?
No, I haven't really noticed myself sleeping more than usual. I also don't feel like I've been moving or speaking any slower than normal.
